title: Kiritani Haruka — A Lavish Feast〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mmm! Every dish is so good!
Which one should I try next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's in this little bowl...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That one's tofu skin. I think you're supposed to top it with this condiment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's wonderful! I love tofu skin!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The proprietress also said that she recommends the wild herb tempura. The herbs were apparently freshly picked on a nearby mountain.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A recommendation...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, Minori, wanna try giving us a quick review?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how nervous you were during our shoot at the cafe? Why don't you take this opportunity to practice since we have such a lovely feast in front of us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Good point...! I've been practicing a ton since then, so I should be a lot better at this now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lemme show you all just how much I've improved!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You sound so eager.
I'm looking forward to what you have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You can do it, Minori.
We believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, then...!
I-I'll get started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm! The batter's so crunchy... And the herbs...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's like the mountain's right in my mouth...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The mountain...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That's quite an expression...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like you still need more practice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
S-Still...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Heya♪ We're here to hang out!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We figured it was time to eat, so we came to see what you were having.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Miku! Rin!
Yes, we were just eating. Can you see everything?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow! That looks amazing!
Oh, what's in this pot?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. We still haven't opened this one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! What do you think's inside?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's have a look.
Ready? Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa!! There's a whole fish inside!
That's so cool! I like this dish already!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Its visual appeal is really astonishing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It really is beautiful.
The vegetables are cut so elegantly, and the plate's even shaped like a bamboo leaf...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only is it delicious, it's also aesthetically pleasing. It's almost a shame that we have to eat it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, that means this dish is just like an idol!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It both looks and tastes amazing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Like the way idols use both feelings and performances to bring fun to their fans♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, idols do have a few things in common with cooking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like wanting your guests to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Who would have thought we could learn about being an idol even from this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've made quite a remarkable observation, Rin. I'm so impressed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. Pretty cool thought, right?♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I wasn't expecting to receive such a lesson from my food. Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Idols and delicious food both have the ability to give people the energy they need.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, since this feast has given us a nice boost of energy, we'll need to do our best during tomorrow's shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
